notes.title: A Bold Approach to Mystery | Dissecting THE PAINSCREEK KILLINGS 1 by Vote 4 Holt
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Recently [url=https://www.youtube.com/@vote4holt]Vote 4 Holt[/url] published an essay style video about mystery games and featured The Painscreek Killings as his case study. He invited 4 players to play The Painscreek Killings and compiled their approach to the game and what route they took. If you already played TPK but want to experience it once again, it is very enjoyable to watch and gives a chance to revisit the town of Painscreek again!

For those who haven't played The Painscreek Killings yet, please take a look at the beginning and see if you would like to try the game yourself!

It is going to be a 3-part video series and part 1 is out now!

[previewyoutube=cy0inXHhAGE;full][/previewyoutube]

As a mystery game developer, it was very informative, and we learned what to improve for our future mystery games.

EQ Studios

notes.title: For any user's facing an black screen/freeze after the Unity Logo.
notes.notes:
Recently a small group of users have faced an issue where the game would freeze on startup after the Unity logo. We aren't quite sure of why this issue occurs, and are currently looking into it. However, we do have a workaround so that you can still play the game.

First disable cloud syncing for The Painscreek Killings. (Right Click TPK in Steam, Properties, Updates, Uncheck Enable Steam Cloud)

Then delete the saveOptionData.txt (this will reset all your settings except the controls) found in ('C:\Users\[username]\AppData\LocalLow\EQ Studios\The Painscreek Killings\SaveData' )

If you cannot find the files, please enable show hidden files in your computer settings.
([url=https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/14201/windows-show-hidden-files]Microsoft link[/url])

We will work to find and solve the root of this issue, but we hope this helps for now.

notes.title: Have You Played The Painscreek Killings?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

I m super into murder mysteries and wandering around falsely idyllic towns, so The Painscreek Killings really spoke to me. There are red phone boxes but dollar signs, yet something about it still feels so quintessentially British. Little did I know that I would get so deep into this mystery that I would end up filling just over 10 A4 sides of paper, with notes scribbled everywhere from the margin to the edge of the pages. It s safe to say this game ate me up whole.

(more…)

notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30706722/425cf0982e29320f1f1360022b129d1ab239e32a.jpg[/img]
Hi everyone. As of today, we've finally finished optimizing the game. This includes the Mansion, which is the heaviest scene in the game, as well as all other smaller and medium-sized scenes which were not originally part of the optimization but we decided to include them as well. Improvements to the game are as follows:

1. Reduced the game's file size from 18GB to 10.6GB, a reduction of about 40%.
2. Reduced RAM usage by approximately 40% when accessing the Village scene.
3. Reduced RAM usage by approximately 30% when accessing Mansion and Hospital scenes.
4. Improved Unity's batching process by about 40%, which is the number of files needed to be read by the CPU, especially when accessing the Mansion and Hospital.
5. Improved load times when switching between scenes during gameplay.
6. Improved prop textures for some locations.
7. Lowered the system requirements to run the game (as shown below).

MINIMUM (updated):
OS: Windows 7/8/10 64-bit
Processor: i3-2120 @3.3GHz
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 745 (or AMD equivalent)
DirectX: Version 11
Storage: 11 GB available space
Additional Notes: *Subject to change after updates

RECOMMENDED (updated):
OS: Windows 7/8/10 64-bit
Processor: i5-2500 @3.3GHz
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 770 (or AMD equivalent)
DirectX: Version 12
Storage: 11 GB available space
Additional Notes: SSD for faster loading time 
*Subject to change after updates

Disclaimer on system requirements:
We have updated our minimum and recommended specs so the game can gaming PCs with moderate (or even slightly lower) specs. However, you may face small freezes when exploring the Village scene. This is due to the way the game now loads only necessary props and unloads the rest. Although some players might find this slightly jarring, we feel it is a necessary trade off to improve the overall loading times. If the game is installed on an SSD, this issue should be non-existent.

Since releasing the game on September 2017, we spent nine months fixing the bugs and optimizing the game. During this time period, we learned a lot about game optimization in general and the Unity game engine. We also stumbled upon an amazing community with mature and helpful players, and are extremely grateful for their patience, help and support. Now that The Painscreek Killings is officially done, the next thing on our list are localization, console and VR ports. We've never attempted them before and thus do not have a set release date yet. However, we will make effort to accomplish them within the shortest time possible. In the meantime, you can follow us on our blog, Facebook or Twitter for more updates and information!

http://eqstudios.blogspot.com/
https://www.facebook.com/EQSLV/
https://twitter.com/EQSLV
http://eqstudios.com/

notes.title: The Painscreek Killings demo now available!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30706722/91e5eeacc8085c3eefa503025cd617c4d53afbb0.jpg[/img]
Hi everyone!

The Painscreek Killings demo is now available to download! It contains the complete Act 1 and the playtime runs between 1 to 3 hours, depending on the player’s play style. The full game will run between 10 to 30 hours for most players.

A few changes were implemented during the creation of the demo that affected the release game permanently but do not break the game. They are as follows:

1. New props were added to some locations and a few items were shifted around to accommodate a better experience for new players.

2. Additional audio content were added to a few key locations that gives reason for players to visit certain locations.

3. About 25% of the game content received proof-reading and grammar check.

4. Players can continue their save game from the demo version to the paid version so they do not have to replay the beginning part again.

With the demo, players can see if they like The Painscreek Killings for what it is - a hardcore whodunit detective game that does not handhold the players and forces them to think like real-life detectives. Due to the high specs required by the game, players can also use the demo to test and see if their computers can handle it. 

If you love stories, give our game a try! 

Enjoy :)

2. Re-scripted the way scenes are loaded/unloaded to reduce RAM strain. This should prevent PCs with 8GB RAM from crashing when loading between heavy scenes.

We are currently hard at work with asset optimization, namely the Hospital and Mansion scenes. We are also cleaning our scripts to reduce garbage collection and memory leaks. Kindly bear with us as we try to make the game experience better for our players.

Note: Regarding the Steam Achievements, some of them are still buggy and are being looked at. However, the ending achievements should now be unlockable.

notes.title: 10/8/2017 patch notes.
notes.notes:
Here a list of things that were patched/implemented:

1. Fixed Hospital's light switch bug which, when accessed, caused the power unit to malfunction.

2. Fixed incorrect date of birth on Vivian's tombstone.

3. Removed a metal blue cabinet inside Oliver's Photo Lab which created collision problem for some players, causing them to be 'pushed off' and fall off the game world.

Note: To rectify issue #3, we tried to implement 'safety nets' in all scenes so players who fell off the game world will be moved to the starting point of that scene. Unfortunately, it caused more problems, such as not being able to go down the well and having the message in the sewer that said "We are sorry that you encountered a game breaking bug" despite the game still running fine. In the end, we removed all the 'safety nets'. 

For anyone who falls off the game world, simply select 'Quit' (do NOT select 'Save and quit'). Then start the game again and everything will be fine. Should you accidentally click on 'Save and quit', just let us know and we will help remedy your situation.

notes.title: Game endings Steam achievements temporarily disabled.
notes.notes:
As you may know, some players encountered the black screen problem at the end of the game. After numerous tests and checking through our scripts, we were still unable to reproduce the problem. 

This seems to happen only to some players. We do not know how many players are affected by it. Since each ending is tied to its own achievement, we decided to disable them in hope that the black screen issue can be bypassed. This way, players can at least see their grades at the end of the game.

We apologize for doing so until a solution has been found, and appreciate your patience for the time being.

Update: Other than the endings, all other achievements can still be unlocked.

notes.title: We are in the process of optimizing the game. Meanwhile, here are some suggestions.
notes.notes:
We are sorry for not getting the game really optimized before releasing it on the store.

The minimum specs listed on Steam, although playable, is unfortunately not an ideal gaming experience due to long load times and low frame rate. We strongly advice to go with the recommended specs. If not, at least have 12GB RAM and/or run the game on a solid state drive. We apologize for needing such steep specs but you will enjoy the game much more. Here’s what we found out:

1. Having more than 8GB RAM will load the game faster. We suggest 12 or even 16GB if possible.

2. We recommend installing the game on a solid state drive as it helps with the loading time tremendously.

3. GTX970 can handle the game’s ‘beautiful’ or ‘fantastic’ settings pretty well. Should the game’s frame rate drop, it’s probably due to the RAM. In that case, we recommend lowering the quality settings.

4. Running the game on ‘good’ settings can still provide an immersive experience, although you will notice shorter shadow distances and more LOD popping in large areas. 

If you have access to a more powerful PC, we hope you can give our game another try. In the meantime, we are looking into optimizing it.

notes.title: Regarding stream recording
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

For anyone who is interested in live streaming or game capturing our game, we tested using a few recording software and experienced the following:
[list]
[*]If you use the application's video capture mode, it sometimes record a black screen instead (for obs, it happens everytime). 
[*]During video capture mode, if you change the game's resolution, the recording will hang even though the game continues running.  
[*]No problems were encountered when testing the screen capture modes. 
[/list]
(We tested the above using OBS, Action!, ShadowPlay and Fraps.)

We noted that some early streamers did not encounter any problem. Hopefully, you will be fine too.

Thank you.
